items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
items.description: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

items.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
items.description: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

items.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
items.description: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.

items.title: Thousands of security personnel deployed as Delhi braces for ‘cockroach’ protest
items.description: Several trains to Delhi have been cancelled and dozens of metro stations are shut to stop protesters from gathering.

items.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
items.description: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

items.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
items.description: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.

items.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
items.description: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

items.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
items.description: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

items.title: Three men found guilty of murdering two Australian surfer brothers and US friend
items.description: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were found at the bottom of a well.

items.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
items.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

items.title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
items.description: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

items.title: Commentator Katie Zacharia picked as new White House press secretary
items.description: The conservative commentator currently works as a communications adviser at Trump Media & Technology Group.

items.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
items.description: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

items.title: US immigration officials defend ICE agents who shot man in same car as child
items.description: Oscar Belgal, the 28-year-old man, survived the shooting and is now being held at a detention facility outside of New York, officials said.

items.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
items.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

items.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
items.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

items.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
items.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

items.title: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars
items.description: It will pick up after the hit 2018 film, starring Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh and Ronny Chieng.

items.title: Doctor accused of 1994 Rwanda genocide offences to face trial in UK
items.description: Dr Vincent Brown was allegedly a "leader" or "supervisor" of violent acts carried out by others in the early days of the genocide.

items.title: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum are recovered
items.description: The two works were seized last month when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera.
